استذميت (form X)
# اِسْتَذْمَيْتُ (istaḏmaytu) /is.tað.maj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اِسْتَذْمَيْتَ (istaḏmayta) /is.tað.maj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اِسْتَذْمَيْتِ (istaḏmayti) /is.tað.maj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اُسْتُذْمِيتُ (ustuḏmītu) /us.tuð.miː.tu/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
